author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m adding 2x4s for the sink cabinets using Simpson Strong-Tie construction screws. I make the blocking slightly bigger than the opening for a tight fit. This makes the installation easier and faster. Ironclad’s Command A5 nitrile dotted gloves are great for projects like this, use coupon code HOME10 at ironclad.com for a discount on your order
